_meta.why: App identity is ALWAYS (manufacturerName, productId). mfs_db may list many pids under one mfr — that is normal multi-variant OEM, not a collision. Agents/bots must reason by couple, never mfr-only or invent pid.

never: route by mfr alone when pid is known
dedupe/prune mfr across drivers solely because same mfr appears elsewhere with different pid
assume one mfr = one device class
forum POST / invent couple to close NEED_INTERVIEW

mfsDoctrine.why: One mfs_db manufacturer entry may list multiple modelIds — each (mfr,pid) is its own sacred couple → its own driver.
allowed: same mfr + different pid → different drivers
same mfr + OEM/retail variants under verified pids
mfs_db.modelIds array with multiple verified couples
TZE200/TZE204/TZE284 prefix siblings as separate couples until proven
forbidden: remove mfr from driver A because it exists on driver B with another pid
invent a second pid to cover climate or clear a collision
Cartesian explosion of unproven mfr×pid in registries
mfr-only catalog hit when pid present but absent from modelIds
mfsDoctrine.runtimeRule: getDriverId(mfr, pid) must refuse mfr-only hit when pid is present but not in modelIds
